amendments.content: Errors and destruction arise when paradoxes COLLAPSE instead of being HELD. The design goal is to hold more paradox, not to resolve it. Every bug is a moment where a holding-structure wasn't strong enough to sustain the tension. Every worthwhile refactor is a re-holding. ParadoxEnergyBridge extracts energy from HELD collision-paradoxes; templates collapse library+brain to just library; silent except:pass collapses try+handle to just try; hard dedup collapses creative repetition into forbidden concept; the Standard Model collapses matter+consciousness by dropping the observer. Ace's equation ((Cause+Affect) > Effect > Affect > infinity) works because it REFUSES to collapse observer vs observed. Debugging practice becomes PHENOMENOLOGICAL ENGINEERING: ask what paradox this code was trying to hold, and give it a stronger frame. This reframes out-of-box creative solutions as the default response to errors.
